content.value_statement: Teams need consistent slide design prompts for NotebookLM. This skill creates Japanese YAML directions for NotebookLM slides and documentation workflows.
actual_capabilities: Routes documentation requests to NotebookLM YAML sub-skills.
Generates two NotebookLM slide design directions with different visual goals.
Asks about purpose, audience, tone, brand elements, and visual balance.
Defines colors, typography, layout rules, and design restrictions.
Produces Japanese YAML guidance for NotebookLM slide customization.
limitations: Focuses on NotebookLM slide design and documentation prompts.
Does not validate generated YAML against an official NotebookLM schema.
Needs source material and brand details for best results.
Does not create final slide files directly.

use_cases.title: Prepare Internal Update Slides
use_cases.description: Create a clear NotebookLM design direction for a product or operations update.

use_cases.title: Compare Presentation Styles
use_cases.description: Generate two visual directions before choosing a deck style.

use_cases.title: Standardize Documentation Handoffs
use_cases.description: Turn source notes into repeatable slide customization guidance.

prompt_templates.title: Create Basic Slide YAML
prompt_templates.prompt: Create NotebookLM slide design YAML for an internal update. Use a clear style and ask only essential questions.

prompt_templates.title: Set Audience and Tone
prompt_templates.prompt: Create two NotebookLM slide design options for executives. Use a trustworthy tone, data-focused layouts, and restrained colors.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Brand Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate NotebookLM slide design YAML using our brand colors, logo guidance, and a mix of chart-heavy and image-light layouts.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Full Presentation System
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for repeatable deck rules.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create two complete NotebookLM design systems for an investor presentation. Include layout types, typography rules, color guidance, and design limits.

output_examples.input: I need NotebookLM slides for an internal product update.
output_examples.output: The skill asks about audience and tone, then provides two Japanese design directions: one corporate and one editorial.

output_examples.input: Create a slide design prompt for a sales presentation.
output_examples.output: The skill returns guidance for colors, typography, page structure, chart treatment, and style restrictions.

best_practices: Provide purpose, audience, tone, and brand colors before generation.
Paste the full generated YAML into NotebookLM slide customization.
Choose one design direction per deck for consistent visuals.
anti_patterns: Use this skill for implementation, code fixes, reviews, or deployments.
Mix both design variants in one presentation without a clear reason.
Ask the skill to invent source facts that are not in your materials.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It creates NotebookLM slide design YAML and related documentation prompts.

faq.question: Does it create slide files directly?
faq.answer: No. It creates instructions that you paste into NotebookLM.

faq.question: What language does it use?
faq.answer: The included templates are written for Japanese NotebookLM slide workflows.

faq.question: Can I use it with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it need brand guidelines?
faq.answer: Brand colors, logo rules, and tone guidance improve the result.

faq.question: Is it safe to use?
faq.answer: The reviewed files contain documentation and YAML examples. No malicious execution behavior was found.
